jobs.description: Job Description:  French Below Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Avionics Retrofit Systems Manager (f/m) to join our Airbus Services team  based in Toulouse, France.As a "Retrofit Systems Manager", you will be responsible for a given set of avionics products of Upgrades Retrofit Projects to drive the technical definition and execution of the engineering retrofit solution (Service Bulletin).Your role and responsibilities:  - Manage a Retrofit project (on-time, cost and quality) end to end from Technical 0ffer or Service Bulletin (SB) launching decision coming from Service Bulletin control Board (SBCB) to SB technical approval and dispatch to the customers, ensuring technical support when required.- For optional upgrade subjects, perform Technical Offers and contribute to ROM at pre-sales phase, in coordination with Airframe Services (SRx) and Sales.- For aircraft product improvement subjects perform the maturity analysis and decide on the launching of the retrofit solution and planning.- Define the most appropriate retrofit solution technical definition based on customer expectations,- Coordinate and contribute to MOD TRS creation/update/justification with Design Office (MOD new) or internally (MOD CTK - Close To Known),- Support Production Center during SB authoring phase,- Perform optional SB Technical Approval as per DOS delegations (after a period of training),- Answer to customer queries (Tech Request) and support working parties, provide RDAF (Technical Adaptation) if necessary,- Identify and develop new products/retrofit solutions in collaboration with Airframe Services and Design Office.You boarding pass:  - Graduated from an Master in electronic or Aeronautical Engineering diploma- Strong knowledge of aircraft avionics systems (at least one of the following ATA 22, 23, 27, 31, 34, 45, 46)- Aircraft configuration management- Airworthiness and safety- Project management- Aircraft maintenance experience would be a plus- Proactive, good team player and good organizational skills- Good communication skills and customer minded- Curious and open-minded for change and continuous improvementGood level in French- Fluent in EnglishYour working environment:Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!How we care for you:Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.Work / Life Balance:  Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application.Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.    Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.Take your career to a new level and apply online now!----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Airbus Commercial Aircraft propose un poste d'Avionics Retrofit Systems Manager (f/h) pour rejoindre notre équipe Airbus Services basée à Toulouse, France.En tant que  Avionics Retrofit Systems Manager, vous serez responsable d'un ensemble donné de produits avioniques, de mener des projets de modernisation et de mise à niveau avion, pour cela vous devrez piloter la définition technique et l'exécution de la solution de modernisation technique (Bulletin de service).Votre rôle et vos responsabilités :- Gérer un projet de Retrofit (délais, coût et qualité) dans son intégralité depuis l'offre technique ou la décision de lancement du Service Bulletin (SB) prise en Service Bulletin Control Board (SBCB) jusqu'à l'approbation technique SB et l'expédition au client, ainsi que le support technique sur demande du client.- Pour les modifications optionnelles vous devrez réaliser les offres techniques et contribuer au ROM en phase d'avant-vente, en coordination avec Airframe Services (SRx) et les Sales,- Pour les mises à niveau avion vous devrez effectuer l'analyse de maturité et décider du lancement du service bulletin ainsi que de son planning.- Définir la définition tec

From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a3D Production Manager (m/f/d)Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, StockholmYOUR TASKS:- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters- Actively contributing to the further development of our companyYOUR PROFILE:- Experience in leadership- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness- Fluent English (business level)OUR TOP 3 REASONS:- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design- Responsibility right from the start- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international companyAfter an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.-------------------Wir sind schnell. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

Give your career a new dimensionCore mission:The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.Your tasks:Your main responsibilities will be the following:- Provide routine and emergency care- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards- Carry out workstation assessments- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentationYour profile:- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.What we offer:Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.Sounds interesting?Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.www.ill.eu/careers
